title: Grafstraße, Unterhaching
description:
English/German:

Bright, quiet 1-room apartment in the south-east of Munich (Unterhaching), with S-Bahn connection to the city of Munich. The apartment is modern and attractively furnished, fully equipped, has vinyl flooring in wood look (suitable for allergy sufferers), is located on the 2nd floor with elevator and has a balcony with a nice view! 

Pack your bags, move in, arrive!

Living/bedroom/kitchen are visually separated by a room divider, bathroom with tub and toilet, 
small balcony with seating, southeast orientation / morning sun. The apartment has a cellar compartment. A shared laundry room is also located in the house.

Rental exclusively temporary, to 1 person.

- Kitchen with stove/oven, fridge/freezer, kettle, coffee machine etc. Kitchen is new!!
- Crockery and cooking utensils fully provided
- Blinds + curtains for blackout on the window front
- Cable TV, smart flat screen TV, Wi-Fi 
- Washing machine in the communal laundry room in the house
- Bed 140x200 cm
- Living/dining area with armchair, room divider, dining table etc.
- Apartment is suitable for 1 person
- Smoking only on the balcony, no pets
- Vacuum cleaner, ironing board, iron, bed linen, towels provided
- Basic equipment cleaning products available

There are always plenty of parking spaces on the street.
All shops for daily needs, doctors and restaurants are within walking distance.

- Kabelfernsehen, smart Flat TV, W-lan

Alle Geschäfte des täglichen Bedarfs, Ärzte und Restaurants befinden sich fußläufig in der näheren Umgebung.

title: Johann-Strauß-Straße, Unterhaching
description:
We offer you a cozy, fully furnished room in a freshly renovated apartment (5-bed flat share) in Unterhaching near Munich with a fantastic balcony (12.6 sqm) and a breathtaking view over the whole of Munich to the Alps!

- Rent: All-inclusive (incl. utilities) between 700 and 799 €; depending on room 
- Facilities:
o Fully furnished: Bed (mattress+topper, bed linen+pillows, bedspread), desk, desk chair, closet with mirror, bed box, TV
o Shower room (WC, shower) and additional separate WC and washing machine available
o Parking space available, can be rented optionally

The apartment is located in Unterhaching, one of Munich's most sought-after suburbs. Here you can enjoy the perfect mix of city life and relaxation:

- Super transportation links:
o Only 17 minutes by S-Bahn to Marienplatz (S-Bahn frequency: every 10 min)
o S-Bahn (S3) and buses in the immediate vicinity; Unterhaching S-Bahn station 7min walk away, bus 2min
o Fast connection to the A8 and A995 for motorists

- Shopping facilities & leisure:
o Large selection of supermarkets (e.g. REWE, EDEKA, ALDI) and drugstores directly on site
o Weekly market for fresh food
o Numerous cafés, restaurants and small stores for everyday needs
o Leisure facilities:
 Swimming pool and fitness studios
 Many green spaces and parks, ideal for jogging, walking or relaxing
 Sports clubs and a wide range of leisure activities in the area

- Short distances to education & work:
o LMU & TUM (Innendstadt): 30min (Sbahn, U-Bahn)
o Infineon & Intel: 9min (car), 20min (S-Bahn) or 6min (bike)
o Bundeswehr Neubiberg: 12min (car), 20min (bus; 217) or 15min (bike)
o Airbus; 14min (car), 30min (bus) or 20min (bike)
o Siemens: 16min (car) or 20min (bike)
